'''Travis Deion Henry''' (born October 29, 1978) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[running back]] for seven seasons in the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[Tennessee Volunteers football|Tennessee Volunteers]]. He was selected by the [[Buffalo Bills]] in the second round of the [[2001 NFL draft]], and also played for the [[Tennessee Titans]] and [[Denver Broncos]]. He was a [[Pro Bowl]] selection in 2002.

Kelce is an eleven-time [[Pro Bowl]]er and a seven-time [[All-Pro]], with four first-team and three second-team selections. During the 2022 season, Kelce became the fifth NFL tight end to reach 10,000 career receiving yards and reached the milestone faster than any tight end in NFL history.<ref name="10,000 yards" /> Kelce was named to the [[NFL 2010s All-Decade Team]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Scott |first=J.P. |date=June 21, 2022 |title=25 Greatest Tight Ends in NFL History |url=https://athlonsports.com/nfl/25-greatest-tight-ends-nfl-history |access-date=August 9, 2022 |website=Athlon Sports |archive-date=August 9, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220809220024/https://athlonsports.com/nfl/25-greatest-tight-ends-nfl-history |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Fragoza |first=James |date=October 24, 2021 |title=13 greatest tight ends of all time from Tony Gonzalez to Jackie Smith |url=https://www.profootballnetwork.com/ranking-top-tight-ends-in-nfl-history/ |access-date=August 9, 2022 |publisher=Pro Football Network |archive-date=August 9, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220809220404/https://www.profootballnetwork.com/ranking-top-tight-ends-in-nfl-history/ |url-status=live }}</ref> During the 2023 season, he surpassed [[Jerry Rice]] in career playoff receptions en route to winning [[Super Bowl LVIII]], his fourth Super Bowl appearance in five seasons.
